The shared increments are b_i−a_i, with longitudinal increments D_j and −D_l. Their total is zero, so the positive parts sum to D_j+Σ(b_i−a_i)_+=m+α+β+Σmax(a_i,b_i), which is also the total magnitude of the negative parts.

The two normalizations divide those totals by D_j and D_l respectively. Each excess above its denominator is a sum of nonnegative shared deficit differences, so the separate and simultaneous equality criteria follow exactly.
